thread:
micah: Kicked off Cumulus-11b onboarding. did a fast quant matrix (fp16 / int8 / int4) across our canonical slices (summarize, chat-multi, rerank). quick notes:
jo: nice. any unexpected perf cliffs?
micah: int4 gives huge cost wins (est ~65% token cost reduction vs fp16) but shows serious regression on multi-turn coherence and extractive QA. int8 is the sweet spot: ~42% cost reduction, latency hit ~+25ms median, p95 ok.
tan: numbers pls — per-1k tokens and latency?
micah: per-1k tokens: fp16 $0.34, int8 $0.20, int4 $0.12. median latency: fp16 92ms, int8 118ms, int4 150ms. p95: fp16 260ms, int4 610ms.
emma: quality deltas? are the regressions concentrated on any prompts?
micah: yes — int4 fails on chain-of-thought/roleplay prompts and the summarization slice loses ~4.5 ROUGE-L vs fp16. int8 drops ~0.9 ROUGE-L. extractive EM drops ~5% on int4.
jo: did you run primed multi-turns/long instruction-following?
micah: ran a priming sweep. int4 error rate climbs with >3 turns, entity hallucinations up. int8 behaviour mirrors fp16 on priming for most slices.
ops-bot: bench artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-onboard/cumulus/5222223333/ (sha256: d1e4...c9f2)
tan: product asks — what routing/recommendation do we give GTN? full-int8 default? hybrid?
emma: I'd recommend hybrid by intent: high-fidelity intents (summarize, long-assist) -> int8 / fp16; low-fidelity (search, simple QA, rerank) -> int4 with safety gating. But because int4 has multi-turn issues, only enable it for stateless requests.
jo: include an explicit SLI: summary-fidelity (ROUGE-L) and entity-precision. if those drop beyond thresholds during rollout, auto-fallback to int8.
micah: agreed. drafted rollout flags:
```
- start: 1% traffic -> cumulus-int8 (all intents)
- day 2: 10% -> split intents (stateless->int4, others->int8)
- monitor: daily eval on sampled summarization + manual triage for primed multi-turn (50 sessions/day)
- rollback: trigger if summary ROUGE-L delta > 1.5 or entity-precision drops > 2.5%
```
ops-bot: canary policy created: canary_cumulus_5222223333 (owner: micah)
emma: for GTN pricing guidance, propose default = cumulus-int8 with an "economy" option that routes stateless low-cost intents to int4. quantify savings in the contract: estimate 28-35% blended token-cost reduction vs fp16 for typical GTN mix.
tan: micah, please upload the scorecard (unit-econ table, delta quality by slice, recommended intent-routing, monitoring queries). need to hand off to solutions by EOD.
micah: will upload in ~2h. bench command used for reproducibility:
```
./run_onboard --model cumulus-11b --quants fp16,int8,int4 --slices summarize,chat-multi,rerank --metrics rouge,exact_match,entity_precision,latency,cost --out cumulus_5222223333.json
```
jo: small ask — include the prompt templates you used for priming tests and sample failures for int4. we want deterministic regression repro.
micah: adding those to the artifacts and linking in the scorecard. pinging @product for visibility. :eyes:
ops-bot: verification passed for artifacts and scorecard link will be added when uploaded.
